PCL Technologies.why: Optical-communication component maker mass-producing customer-specified products for data-center build-outs and AI, now adding precision mechanical parts for co-packaged optics (MT ferrules, ELSFP connector components).
PCL Technologies.evidence: PCL Technologies MOPS material information: release 4977-20260506-2 (05-08-2026): optical communication components, optical path design and optical component packaging for data-center and AI; CPO precision parts such as MT Ferrule for CPO and ELSFP Dissipation Connector Component.

players.product: Optical communication components (optical-path design and optical-component packaging) for data-center and AI products; entering precision plastic/metal mechanical parts for CPO (e.g. MT ferrule for CPO, ELSFP dissipation connector component) via the Pingood acquisition

quarterly_data.signal: Board of subsidiary PCL International Technologies (Penang) resolved on 2026-04-14 to buy a plant in Batu Kawan Industrial Park, Penang, Malaysia: land of 4.21 acres and a 183,246.34 square-foot building for MYR68,580,000, from Foong Chi Mould Industries (not a related party), to own its plant for operations and production
